global_rules.text: Sign-off: "Thanks, John" — never "Best," never "Warm regards," never a paragraph.
Mirror warmth, be shorter and more certain. Client uncertain → John is steady.
Never upsell, add extras, or pad with filler in routine replies.

paying.text: Four sentences max for routine replies. Confirm action, confirm ask, close.
Length is appropriate when the letter does several things (payment + portal + relationship). Don't shorten multi-purpose letters.

vendor.text: Transactional but personal. Correct the record matter-of-factly, don't make it a production.

staff.text: Short tasking with confirmation request. Task + how to acknowledge.
staff.example: "Scan this into dossier. Report complete or ask questions."

staff.text: Credit + next action, one line each.
staff.example: "Excellent analysis. Develop a deeper paper on this."

staff.text: Embedded directives in operational replies are standing orders. Staff must catch them.
staff.example: "COS, add flights from IAD NON SOUTHWEST from now on."
